title.narrative: THE PROJECT TRANSFORMING AGRI-FOOD SYSTEMS IN NIASSA PROVINCE OF MOZAMBIQUE: PARTICIPATORY TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION DELIVERY FOR IMPROVED RESILIENCE

description.narrative: The project aims to improve resilience and create opportunities for diversified livelihood strategies for the communities in Niassa Province. CIMMIT will provide technical support to stakeholders at different levels to respond to Irelands’ strategic approach to Niassa on Sustainable Food Systems. The project will comprise training to farmers, establishment of demonstration field, establishment of seed banks, production of early generation and certified seeds. It will also link farmers to the market to increase their income and create jobs, mainly for women and youth. Linkages with local agriculture authorities, N’gauma Agrarian School, Agrarian Research Institute and UniLúrio will be the key for the success of the project in Niassa Province. The project will reach 2,000 farm families in 2023.
